thread:
vivian: Quick heads-up  Acme pushed a formal ask: per-route cost attribution + traceable routing decisions across Hosted and Dedicated. They want a small UI and secure export. Can we scope for an MVP this sprint?

sam: TL;DR: MVP = 3 cards (latency tail, cost/request, errors by route), trace tags for routing + cache, weekly secure export. Keep cardinality low.

neil: Agree. Runtime plan: add span attributes for route_name, route_version, cache_hit. Use a feature-flag gate so we can enable in canary pools. Low-risk if we don't add extra dims.

anya: UI constraints: keep to compact tiles. Need tenant dropdown + quick-presets (1h/6h/24h/7d). Add an "Export" button on cost card. I can mock two variants: table-first and chart-first.

marta: Compliance note: Acme needs S3 with customer-specific KMS key + weekly delivery and retention 90 days. Also wants alerting on >30% week-over-week cost delta.

obs-bot: Pipeline alert: metrics ingestion currently only has model_name and region tags. Missing route_name and model_variant. Dashboards will require schema change.

vivian: Proposed Launch Acceptance:
- Dashboards show p99 latency (route-scoped), avg token-cost/request (route & model_family), and error% by route
- Traces include route_name & cache_hit attributes
- Weekly CSV export delivered to customer S3 (KMS + ACL)
- Canary: 5% traffic, 72h monitor window, automatic flag rollback triggers
- Alerts: cost spike & p99 breach rules configured
- Perf: tail overhead < 5%

sam: Engineering notes: add runtime flag: "observability.route_tags": true. Example snippet for runtime instrumention:```
span.set_attribute("route_name", route.name)
span.set_attribute("route_version", route.version)
span.set_attribute("cache_hit", cache_hit ? "true" : "false")
```
Also: add a bounded mapping table on ingestion to translate route aliases -> canonical route ids to avoid metric proliferation.

neil: Canary plan: feature flag + sampling override to ensure canary traces are captured. Canary metrics to monitor: p99 latency, 95p token cost, error rate, and ingestion lag. Rollback if p99 > baseline * 1.2 or error_rate > baseline * 2.

anya: Deliverables this week: wireframes by Wed (1766101200) and small prototype flow showing export modal. Prefer export options: S3 (customer bucket), SFTP (for on-prem).

marta: I'll coordinate S3 & KMS with Acme and legal. ETA Fri (1766103600). Also will confirm SLAs for CSV delivery time.

vivian: Risk register snippets:
- Metric cardinality -> store cost & retention growth. Mitigate with aliasing + canonicalization.
- Runtime overhead -> bench and canary.
- Dedicated/on-prem delivery complexity -> provide multiple export transports but flag as enterprise-only.

sam: Timeline rough:
- Sprint 1: runtime tagging + bench + ingestion schema update
- Sprint 2: dashboard UI + export plumbing + S3 delivery
- Sprint 3: canary rollout + monitors + docs
We can parallelize UI and tagging work.

neil: I'll own canary config + runbook. Will add explicit pager thresholds and rollback steps. Draft by Tue (1766101800).

anya: Will post mocks Wed noon (1766101200). If team prefers narrow MVP, pick table-first UI to speed dev.

marta: I'll collect S3 KMS ARNs and retention policy by Fri. Also flag: Acme requires audit logs of exports.

obs-bot: Reminder: update metrics schema doc and notify infra ingestion team once tags are finalized.

vivian: OK team  consensus to proceed with scoped MVP. Follow-up sync Thu to lock acceptance and create tickets. Thanks. :rocket:
